name: Meilifeilong
sum: The best-preserved chaoyangopterid, from the Early Cretaceous Jiufotang Formation of Liaoning, China.
wsnote: M. youhao about 2.16 m; M. sanyainus 2.05–2.18 m.
holotype: IVPP V 16059 (M. youhao) — Xiaotaizi layer, Jiufotang Formation, Jianchang, Liaoning.
material: Nearly complete skeleton and skull missing the tail; second species M. sanyainus from a complete skull and skeleton.
biology: Low backward-extending crest; a toothless ground-foraging azhdarchoid.
author: Wang et al. 2023
